# W0-001 — Revalidate repository baseline

- Phase: W0
- Status: `done`
- Priority: P0
- Role: auditor
- Dependencies: none
- Parallel group: serial
- Risk: low
- Human approval required: false

## Objective

Confirm repository root, branch and exact HEAD before any modification.

## Scope hints

- `repository root`
- `.git`

## Deliverables

- Baseline report with current SHA, worktree state, branch protection observations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Repository is A-L-L-A-H/mw-xv.
- [x] Work begins from latest dev; no hard reset, force push or destructive checkout.
- [x] Record current HEAD and dirty files.

## Verification

- `git status --short --branch`
- `git rev-parse HEAD`

## Completion record

- Commands / exit codes:
  - `git status --short --branch` — exit 0
  - `git rev-parse HEAD` — exit 0
  - `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/dev` — exit 0
- Evidence paths:
  - `evidence/W0-001-baseline.md`
- Commit SHA: c8041a9cf5cce526af4315dea04294aea7e2ac4a
- Reviewer decision: Acceptance evidence recorded.
- Residual issues: Verified origin points to A-L-L-A-H/mw-xv; local dev HEAD exactly matched remote dev. Existing dirty worktree preserved. Branch-protection rules remain unverified from local metadata.

## Notes

Keep this task atomic. Do not expand into unrelated refactors.

# W1-001 — Approve canonical MoonWitness art direction

- Phase: W1
- Status: `done`
- Priority: P0
- Role: art-director
- Dependencies: W0-006
- Parallel group: serial
- Risk: low
- Human approval required: true

## Objective

Formalize the user's zine/punk/manga reference into a production-grade visual bible while preserving current brand identity.

## Scope hints

- `packages/ui/README.md`
- `packages/ui/TOKENS.md`
- `docs/design/visual-direction.md`

## Deliverables

- Visual Bible section: art direction, palette roles, linework, cel shading, grunge, composition and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Primary identity remains MoonWitness XV, not a generic anime template.
- [x] Reference DNA is interpreted, not copied from copyrighted franchises.
- [x] Black/ink, paper/white, hot magenta, electric blue/cyan and signal yellow are token-mapped.
- [x] Grunge, manga ink, photocopy, ripped paper and urban anime environment have controlled intensity tiers.

## Verification

- `visual review via UI Catalog`

## Completion record

- Commands / exit codes:
  - `user approval in chat; checked existing UI token palette and WCAG AA tests` — exit 0
- Evidence paths:
  - `MWXV_ULTRA_COMPLETE_VISUAL_UNIVERSE_AUTONOMOUS_PACK/evidence/art-direction-proposal.md`
- Commit SHA: c92b1bce67534eb7196246e9c6068efac0a14a11
- Reviewer decision: Acceptance evidence recorded.
- Residual issues: Approved by user in chat on 2026-11-22 (Asia/Jakarta). Accepted the art-direction proposal at evidence/art-direction-proposal.md as canonical, retaining the existing MoonWitness token identity and its stated safeguards.

## Notes

Human approval required only for canonical style lock. Continue other independent audit work while waiting.
